content.value_statement: Claude Code components can have vague descriptions, excessive permissions, weak triggers, or incomplete documentation. This skill turns quality findings into focused, reviewable improvements while preserving intended behavior.
actual_capabilities: Reviews agents, skills, commands, and hooks using supplied quality findings.
Rewrites vague descriptions with specific capabilities and activation criteria.
Evaluates tool permissions and recommends removing unjustified access.
Adds usage guidance, examples, capability lists, and clearer document structure.
Presents prioritized changes, before-and-after comparisons, and validation checklists.
limitations: Requires component content and quality findings; it does not provide an included scoring engine.
Uses only Read and Edit tools, so it cannot run validation scripts or shell commands.
References scripts and templates that are not included in the audited package.
Heuristic improvements require human review when component behavior or permissions are ambiguous.

use_cases.title: Refine a New Skill
use_cases.description: Improve a new skill description, trigger rules, permissions, examples, and documentation before release.

use_cases.title: Reduce Component Permissions
use_cases.description: Review an over-permissioned component and retain only tools required by its documented behavior.

use_cases.title: Prepare Marketplace Submissions
use_cases.description: Apply quality findings and produce a clear summary of changes, score impact, and remaining recommendations.

prompt_templates.title: Improve a Skill Description
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [component path]. Improve its description with clear capabilities and activation criteria. Preserve its purpose and show the before-and-after text.

prompt_templates.title: Review Tool Permissions
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the allowed tools in [component path]. Explain each permission, remove unjustified access, and preserve all documented workflows.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Quality Findings
prompt_templates.prompt: Use these quality findings for [component path]: [findings]. Prioritize critical issues, apply incremental edits, and summarize each change with its expected impact.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Marketplace-Ready Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Improve [component path] for marketplace review. Address security, schema, permissions, triggers, usability, examples, and documentation. Validate consistency and report unresolved concerns.

output_examples.input: Improve the vague description in my testing skill.
output_examples.output: Updated the description to name the testing framework, activation phrases, generated test types, and expected coverage. The component purpose remains unchanged.

output_examples.input: Review this research skill with broad tool access.
output_examples.output: Removed file modification, command execution, and delegation permissions because the documented workflow only reads local files and retrieves web sources.

output_examples.input: Apply these marketplace quality findings to my command.
output: Clarified the command action and expected result.
Added specific usage conditions and two practical examples.
Retained one recommendation for human review because its compatibility impact is uncertain.

best_practices: Provide the component file and its quality findings before requesting edits.
Apply one improvement category at a time and review each change.
Validate schema, permissions, behavior, and examples after editing.
anti_patterns: Do not remove permissions without checking every documented workflow.
Do not rewrite component behavior when the request only concerns quality.
Do not treat example quality scores as measured validation results.

faq.question: Which component types can this skill improve?
faq.answer: It covers Claude Code agents, skills, commands, and hooks.

faq.question: Does it analyze component quality independently?
faq.answer: It expects quality findings or user guidance. The audited package does not include a scoring engine.

faq.question: Can it run tests or validation scripts?
faq.answer: No. Its declared tools are Read and Edit, so command execution is unavailable.

faq.question: Will it preserve existing behavior?
faq.answer: Preserving purpose and usage is a stated principle, but ambiguous changes still require human review.

faq.question: Can it improve security?
faq.answer: It can reduce unnecessary permissions, recommend input validation, and document safer tool usage.

faq.question: Are the referenced scripts and templates included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md, so those referenced assets are unavailable.
